plain: Money a government gives to help an industry, a group, or an ally

webster.text: Aid in money; supply given; a tax; something furnished for aid, as by the people to their prince; as the subsidies granted formerly to the kings of England.

example.quote: The power of making Treaties involves the case of subsidies, and here as an additional evil, foreign influence is to be dreaded.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, September 6, 1787
